name: Kodoku
subtitle: SideStore & AltStore source for Kodoku (free Apple ID fork of Aidoku)
description:
SideStore and AltStore source for Kodoku, an open-source fork of Aidoku tailored for free Apple ID sideloading and cross-device sync.

Source code & releases: https://github.com/sfai05/Aidoku

apps.name: Kodoku
apps.subtitle: Open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS (Aidoku fork)
apps.localizedDescription: Kodoku is an open-source fork of Aidoku built for free Apple ID sideloading via SideStore/AltStore, with planned self-hostable sync and manga management enhancements. Licensed under GPLv3.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aidoku needs FaceID permissions for user-defined settings
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to save pages in your photo library
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to connect to local Komga and Kavita servers

versions.localizedDescription: Add PocketBase bidirectional sync core, Sync Status Dashboard, One-Time Setup Wizard, pb_schema.json export, Sync Logs viewer, and experimental recovery tools.
Initial Kodoku SideStore/AltStore release (free Apple ID compatible, blue Kodoku icon).
